Attention was drawn to the disproportionate impact of civilian shipping attacks on the Global South, which jeopardise the availability and cost of fuel, food, and fertilisers amid the West Asian crisis. The address emphasised preserving freedom of navigation under international law, halting the weaponisation of supply chains, and building resilient connectivity. Uttarakhand Chopper Crash: Six Killed, DGCA Team To Probe, Final Moments Caught On Video
A helicopter carrying six people, including a pilot and five passengers from Karnataka, crashed in Joshimath Valley in Uttarakhand's Chamoli district, killing everyone on board. The chopper departed from Badrinath around 1:14 PM before crashing in the valley. The victims' mortal remains have been recovered and are being transported back to Karnataka. Moments before the fatal tragedy, passengers recorded videos from inside the chopper, capturing the journey and the cloudy conditions prior to takeoff. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has sent a team to conduct a preliminary assessment and investigate whether inclement weather contributed to the disaster. Serious concerns have emerged over aviation safety regulations and permissions granted to private helicopter operators along pilgrimage routes in the mountainous terrain.
Israel Vote Fraud Row, US Midterms Impact on India & G20 Atlanta Meet
This episode of Statecraft examines major global political battles and their geopolitical repercussions. In Israel, following an inconclusive general election where Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing bloc secured 53 seats, the Likud party alleged widespread electoral fraud and foreign interference involving Arab parties, Qatar, and Turkey. Israeli election authorities and police found no evidence of systematic fraud or altered outcomes. Meanwhile, rival opposition factions and Arab parties hold potential kingmaker positions amid tense coalition maneuvers. Across the Atlantic, the upcoming US midterm elections threaten Republican control of Congress, presenting significant implications for India. With bilateral trade negotiations stalled over agriculture and Russian oil imports, shifts on Capitol Hill could reshape US tariff policies, trade scrutiny, and strategic ties. In diplomatic developments, External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar arrived in Atlanta for the G20 foreign ministers meeting and Quad deliberations chaired by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, before heading to the Commonwealth summit. The show concludes with scenes of physical brawls erupting inside Armenia's parliament.
Rahul Gandhi vs Nirmala Sitharaman on IDBI Bank Privatisation, PSU Valuation & Tata Group
A major political clash has erupted between Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi and Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman over the proposed privatization of IDBI Bank. Rahul Gandhi accused the Narendra Modi government of undervaluing a premier public institution built during the Congress era and questioned the bidding process, also raising concerns regarding employee rights. Hitting back, Nirmala Sitharaman defended the sale, asserting that all prescribed procedures were followed and blaming Congress-era crony lending for burdening IDBI Bank with massive bad loans. The controversy follows previous exchanges between both leaders regarding corporate governance and alleged government interference in the Tata Group. On the broadcast, experts including SBI Group Chief Economic Advisor Soumya Kanti Ghosh, former Finance Secretary S.C. Garg, and political analyst Rajat Sethi debated the bank's turnaround, reserve price revisions, and the valuation benchmark set for the stake sale to Fairfax Financial Holdings. In a subsequent segment, Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav outlined anti-pollution measures across Delhi-NCR.
Rain Disrupts INDIA Bloc Event; Gyanesh Kumar Impeachment Postponed, Ramlila Rally On
Rain lashed Delhi, upsetting the INDIA bloc's arrangements to stage a public impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar at Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge's 10 Rajaji Marg residence. The downpour washed away sound and lighting systems on the lawns and drenched tables and tents, leaving the setup covered under waterproof sheets. Following the disruption, Rahul Gandhi addressed a joint press conference alongside allied leaders, announcing that the symbolic event has been delayed by 24 hours to Saturday noon. Leaders stressed that the mass outreach will take place ahead of their scheduled mega Ramlila Maidan march on November 1.
